svg.title: BCM70015 native SCL filter map: six measured trials
svg.desc: Actual native first-frame thumbnails, sampled width-specific controls, all six paired ENABLE values, and all384 unsigned12 coefficient fields. Native delivery passed every trial; three unequal sequential maps remained diagnostic FAIL.
svg.text: 2026-10-05 · stock MPEG2 640×360 · 180 pictures/session · 432 fixed reads/trial · zero custom SCL writes
Actual first-frame RGB thumbnails (display resampling only); full packed-byte comparisons are the oracle.
Six preregistered observations: paired ENABLE, no retry-until-stable
All 192 coefficient words / 384 unsigned12 fields match across all 12 passes.
Colour encodes raw 12-bit fields (0 blue → 4095 yellow), not signed filter weights or Q format.
Native EOS, full pixels and cleanup: all nine sessions PASS, including frozen H264 recovery.
Sequential samples ≠ active-latch / transport / source-lease / arithmetic / standalone-processing proof.
Exact paired words, hashes, admission and uncertainties: native-scl-filter-map.json
